faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before getting started
faq.a1: You can get started for free. For full access to all templates and PDF downloads, we offer a premium plan from $9.99/month or a 14-day trial for $0.99.
faq.q2: Can I change templates without losing my data?
faq.a2: Yes. Your data is separated from the template. You can switch between the 12 templates at any time and your content will adapt automatically.
faq.q3: In what formats can I download my CV?
faq.a3: You can currently download as high-resolution PDF, optimized for printing and electronic submission.
faq.q4: Can I create more than one CV?
faq.a4: Yes. With the premium plan you can create unlimited CVs, allowing you to tailor your resume for different positions or industries.
faq.q5: Can I import my existing CV?
faq.a5: Yes. You can import your CV in PDF or Word (.docx) format and the system will automatically extract your information to populate the editor.
faq.a6: Absolutely. We use bank-level encryption and never share your data with third parties. You can delete your account and all your data at any time.
